es: Dia completo mixto: GC rompio 3 dias de tesis bajista con un dia fuerte al alza (+1.3%), YM confirmo su 2a sesion liderando el alza, NQ y CL cerraron practicamente PLANOS pese a rangos violentos, ES cerro alcista neto contra su propio sesgo corto.
NQ: patron de 'giro de 1 dia' (2 seguidos) se rompio hoy -- balance/chop pegado a resistencia POC/VAH, sin resolver.
ES: peor dia de precision del complejo, marco crudo se desalineo otra vez del sesgo fusionado.
GC: 4o test del cluster 4383-4424 perdio memoria tras 3 rechazos seguidos -- tesis bajista ROTA, nueva tesis alcista desde cero.
YM: 2/2 sesiones liderando la divergencia alcista frente a NQ/ES -- primer patron propio medible.
CL: el inventario EIA si movio el precio (nuevo maximo semanal) pero no pudo sostenerse, cerro plano.
Aun no reabre Globex (17:00 CT) al momento de esta corrida -- niveles de gap/DO/TDO/ONH/ONL de la nueva sesion se confirman con el reopen; se usa el cierre de hoy como referencia.
Semana de NFP (viernes 4-sep) -- Asia de hoy sin eventos de alto impacto, pero NY de manana trae Claims/ISM Services/reporte de gas natural (medios), manos fuera moderadas.
Sizing: limite $1,000 por cuenta (K=3 stops) -- casi todas las zonas de hoy piden micros, no full, para no quemar el limite en 1-2 stops.
en: Mixed full day: GC broke a 3-day bearish thesis with a strong up day (+1.3%), YM confirmed its 2nd session leading the rally, NQ and CL closed nearly FLAT despite violent ranges, ES closed net bullish against its own short bias.
NQ: the '1-day reversal' pattern (2 in a row) broke today -- balance/chop stuck against POC/VAH resistance, unresolved.
ES: the complex's worst accuracy day, the raw framework misaligned from the fused bias again.
GC: the 4th test of the 4383-4424 cluster lost its memory after 3 straight rejections -- bearish thesis BROKEN, new bullish thesis from scratch.
YM: 2 for 2 sessions leading the bullish divergence against NQ/ES -- its first measurable own pattern.
CL: the EIA inventory did move price (new weekly high) but couldn't hold it, closed flat.
Globex hasn't reopened yet (17:00 CT) as of this run -- gap/DO/TDO/ONH/ONL levels for the new session confirm at the reopen; today's close is used as reference.
NFP week (Friday Sep 4) -- tonight's Asia has no high-impact events, but tomorrow's NY brings Claims/ISM Services/natural gas storage (medium), moderate hands-off windows.
Sizing: $1,000 per-account limit (K=3 stops) -- almost every zone tonight calls for micros, not full, to avoid burning the limit in 1-2 stops.

counterCase.en: the rejection at 90.97 TWICE in the same day (morning and afternoon) is real evidence of supply there -- it could be the start of a bearish reversal of the weekly bullish bias, not just noise -- I keep it but downgrade: underlying bias to medium conviction, no entries until seeing which edge of the 89.04-92.29 range gives first tomorrow

reason.es: sin catalizador en Asia (el inventario ya paso hoy, el proximo es la semana que viene); precio en medio de un rango recien establecido 89.04-92.29 -- espera que un borde ceda con confirmacion, no lo persigas en ninguno de los dos lados
reason.en: no catalyst in Asia (the inventory already happened today, the next one is next week); price sits in the middle of a freshly-established 89.04-92.29 range -- wait for an edge to give with confirmation, don't chase either side

ES.es: thesisAlign en CONFLICT -- el corto de fondo pierde apoyo de las fuentes crudas. El H/L probable se forma entre 7618.50 (low) y 7691.25 (nuevo maximo), con 7674-7691 como el nivel bisagra: si cede al alza, el dia es de recuperacion; si rechaza otra vez, el corto retoma mando.
ES.en: thesisAlign in CONFLICT -- the underlying short is losing support from the raw sources. The day's H/L will likely form between 7618.50 (low) and 7691.25 (new high), with 7674-7691 as the hinge level: if it gives way to the upside, the day is a recovery; if it rejects again, the short regains control.

GC.es: tesis nueva alcista desde hoy. Estirado 15.4 ATR -- riesgo real de pausa/pullback en Asia antes de continuar. El cluster roto 4383-4424 es el nivel a vigilar: un pullback con rechazo alcista confirma la ruptura, perder 4369.70 la pone en duda.
GC.en: new bullish thesis as of today. Stretched 15.4 ATR -- real risk of a pause/pullback in Asia before continuing. The broken cluster 4383-4424 is the level to watch: a pullback with a confirmed bullish rejection confirms the break, losing 4369.70 puts it in question.

YM.es: 2a sesion confirmando el liderazgo alcista de YM sobre el complejo. Estirado 4.05 ATR -- comprar el pullback a 53112-53202, no el toque. Perder 52885 revive el corto semanal de fondo.
YM.en: 2nd session confirming YM's bullish leadership over the complex. Stretched 4.05 ATR -- buy the pullback into 53112-53202, not the touch. Losing 52885 revives the underlying weekly short.

CL.en: no catalyst in Asia (the inventory already happened today). Freshly-formed range 89.04-92.29, with 90.97 as the level that rejected twice today. Fade the edges with confirmation, no chasing. Tomorrow's NY brings Claims/ISM Services/natural gas storage, none crude-specific.
